 Food Recalls Weekly Food Recalls Impacting Georgia
 November 6, 2026 - by BainbridgeGA.com - Leave a Comment 
 Share Tweet Share 
 Snack Right Super Foods, Inc., doing business as Brad’s Raw Chips , is recalling certain Brad’s Plant Based Crunchy Kale (2 oz) and Brad’s Veggie Chips Kale (3 oz) products because they may contain thallium. 
 Thallium (Tl) is a naturally occurring metal found in the soil and in sulfur-based minerals. It can be taken up by plants and vegetables, particularly those in the Brassicaceous family (i.e., cabbage, radish). Acute or chronic exposure to thallium at relatively high levels can result in serious adverse health effects , including gastroenteritis, damage to peripheral nerves, and alopecia (hair loss).
 The products were distributed nationwide through KeHE Distributors and United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) , and sold directly to five individual consumers. Approximately 25,000 bags (about 2,097 cases) of the recalled products are estimated to be in commerce. Distribution occurred between October 2025 and December 2025 .
 The recall includes the following Brad’s Plant Based products , all in bags, distributed under the brand name Brad’s Plant Based, with the lot numbers and Best By dates listed below:
 Brad’s Crunchy Kale, Original 
 2 oz (57g) bag
 UPC 813104021679 
 Lots 33525-1, 33525-2 and 33525 -3 (Best By February 1, 2027 )
 Lot 34525-1 (Best By February 11, 2027 )
 Lot 35125-2 (Best By February 17, 2027 )
 Brad’s Crunchy Kale, Cheeze It Up 
 2 oz (57g) bag
 UPC 813104021877 
 Lot 35025-3 (Best By February 16, 2027 )
 Brad’s Crunchy Kale, Radical Ranch 
 2 oz (57g) bag
 UPC 813104020726 
 Lot 29425-1 (Best By December 21, 2026 )
 Brad’s Veggie Chips Kale 
 3 oz (85g) bag
 UPC 854615002054 
 Lot 33225-3 (Best By January 28, 2027 )
 Lot 33325-2 (Best By January 29, 2027 )
 Lot 33425-1 (Best By January 30, 2027 )
 Lot 33525-1 (Best By February 1, 2027 )
 In May 2026, the California Department of Public Health (CDPH) advised consumers not to eat certain Brad’s Plant Based products after it investigated an inquiry from one individual with elevated thallium levels. 
 CDPH collected samples at retail stores in the Sacramento area, and laboratory testing found elevated thallium levels in multiple varieties. The recall was initiated after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) advised the firm of thallium in tested products. Brassica crops such as kale are known to accumulate certain elements from soil. The manufacturing process did not introduce the contaminant; however, the dehydration process removes approximately 85 to 90 percent of the product’s water, which concentrates elements already present in the fresh kale.
 Consumers who have purchased any of the products listed above should stop consuming them immediately and discard the product. Refunds are not being offered, and the product should not be returned to the place of purchase.
 Consumers with questions may contact Alexa Olvera at Snack Right Super Foods, Inc. by email at [email protected] , Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Consumers can expect a response within one business day.
 Consumers who believe they may have experienced adverse health effects from consumption of these products should contact their health care provider.
 This voluntary recall is being conducted with the knowledge of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
 Once Upon a Farm (Berkeley, CA) is recalling all lots and varieties of fruit-flavored Tractor Wheel Organic Toddler Soft-Baked bars due to reports that the composition of the Tractor Wheel toddler snack can rapidly hydrate into a dense, dry, and sticky mass upon contact with saliva and during chewing , which can result in a potential choking hazard for toddlers for ages 1.5-2.5 years old .
 The Tractor Wheels were distributed nationwide, including Puerto Rico, and reached consumers via online sales and retail stores . This recall covers all lot codes currently available in distribution, including expired products which may be on consumers’ shelves. Applicable unexpired Best If Used by Dates are 10/30/2026 to 8/26/2027 . 
 Recalled products can be identified as follows: 
 Tractor Wheels – Strawberry, Pumpkin & Beet 
 5 count – Net Wt. 3.35 oz (95g)
  UPC 81000351261 
 10 count – Net Wt. 6.7 oz (190 g)
 UPC 810003512932 
 Tractor Wheels – Apple, Sweet Potato & Spinach 
 5 count – Net Wt. 3.35 oz (95g)
 UPC 81000351260 
 10 count – Net Wt. 6.7 oz (190 g)
 UPC 810003512840 
 Tractor Wheels – Banana, Pumpkin & Cauliflower 
 5 count – Net Wt. 3.35 oz (95g)
 UPC 81000351262 
 Tractor Wheels (Variety Pack) – Strawberry, Pumpkin & Beet/Apple, Sweet Potato & Spinach 
 20 count – (10) Apple, (10) Strawberry – Net Wt. 13.4 oz (380g)
 UPC 810003512918 
 TW 30 Ct Variety Pack – Strawberry, Pumpkin & Beet (10ct)/Apple, Sweet Potato & Spinach (10ct), Banana, Pumpkin & Cauliflower (10ct) 
 30 count – Net Wt. 20.1 oz (570g)
 UPC 810003512925 
 – Online Only – Organic Baby & Toddler Snack Sampler Packs containing 5 count cartons of Tractor Wheels along with other Baby and Toddler Snack products 
 Organic Baby & Toddler Snack Sampler 9 count
 Contains 3 – 5 count cartons of tractor wheels all three flavors – Case 10810003513670 
 Organic Baby & Toddler Snack Sampler 12 count
 Contains 3 – 5 count cartons of tractor wheels all three flavors – Case 10810003513694 
 Organic Ultimate Snack Sampler 15 count
 Contains 3 – 5 count cartons of tractor wheels all three flavors – Case 10810003513687 
 The decision to recall these products was based on three consumer complaints that were reported to FDA for choking . No injuries have been reported to date. We are working with the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) to make sure affected products are removed as the company works on reformulating and families have the information they need.
 Consumers who have purchased this recalled Once Upon a Farm Tractor Wheels product should not open the package or consume the products. Instead, they should return the product to the location of purchase for a full refund or contact [email protected] .
 Consumers with questions should contact the company at  [email protected] or call 1-888-983-1606 to contact our customer care team Monday – Friday: 6:00 am – 4:30 pm, PST and Saturday: 8:00 am – 11:00 am, PST.
 We are sorry for the worry and disruption this has caused parents, caregivers, and our retail partners.
